title: Fish 'n' bread

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Fish 'n' bread is a Mistlands-tier food.

sections.heading: Recipe
sections.text:
Uncooked fish n' bread is produced in a Food preparation table with:
• 1 Anglerfish
• 2 Bread dough
Fish 'n' bread is produced by cooking Uncooked fish n' bread in a Stone oven for 50 seconds. If left in the oven for 100 seconds, it will burn and turn into Coal.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • Prior to the fishing update, acquiring Anglerfish required a multi-step crafting process to obtain the correct bait. With the process simplified, Anglerfish are still time-intensive to catch, but perhaps not as prohibitive as before.

Fish 'n' bread

Type: Food | Internal ID: FishAndBread | Source: Stone oven | Usage: Eating | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Crafting Materials: Uncooked fish n' bread x1 | Max Health: 30 | Max Stamina: 90 | Duration: 30m | Healing: 3 hp/tick

Introduction. Fish 'n' bread is a Mistlands-tier food.

Recipe. Uncooked fish n' bread is produced in a Food preparation table with:
• 1 Anglerfish
• 2 Bread dough
Fish 'n' bread is produced by cooking Uncooked fish n' bread in a Stone oven for 50 seconds. If left in the oven for 100 seconds, it will burn and turn into Coal.

Notes. • Prior to the fishing update, acquiring Anglerfish required a multi-step crafting process to obtain the correct bait. With the process simplified, Anglerfish are still time-intensive to catch, but perhaps not as prohibitive as before.
